metrics.correctness_contract: detailed scene caption correctly describing the fixed nyc.jpg content (city view, binoculars, buildings, sky)

input_asset.description: NYC street photo bundled by the upstream vlm-chatbot notebook; used by the florence2 and yolov26 twins (byte-identical to pinned-snapshot copy, verified 2026-10-08)

metrics.output: A view of a city from the top of a building. There is a large silver binoculars on a metal stand. There are many tall buildings in the city. The sky above the city is blue with white clouds.

metric_semantics.peak_vram_gb: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() — peak ALLOCATED GPU tensor memory via PyTorch's caching allocator. NOT total physical VRAM usage (driver/runtime reservations and other processes are excluded).
metric_semantics.latency_s: wall time of one full workload invocation including torch.cuda.synchronize()
metric_semantics.load_s: wall time of model+processor construction (from_pretrained/pipeline load)
metric_semantics.rtf: standard RTF = inference_time / generated_or_input_audio_duration (lower is faster; <1 is real-time capable)
metric_semantics.realtime_speed_factor: inverse RTF = audio_duration / inference_time (higher is faster) — reported separately, never mixed with rtf
